yaya.info.label: Info sources
yaya.info.desc: Structured public-data channels (encyclopedia, scholarly, geocoding, countries…): create instances, toggle each, and let the AI query several in one fetch_info call
yaya.info.cfg_instances_desc: Each: {name, type, template?, params?, note?, enabled?}; the editor on this page is easier
yaya.info.hint: One row = one channel; leave the template empty to use the type default ({query} is your search term). The AI names channels by “name” or “type id” in fetch_info, several per call.
yaya.info.empty: No channels yet — press “Add channel” below
yaya.info.name: Name (how the AI calls it)
yaya.info.saved: Saved — the next fetch_info call uses the new setup
yaya.info.err_name: Name is required (the AI calls it by name)
